judged_text: packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:86 — response.statusText !== "OK"` is the sole success check on the Salesforce token response; `statusText` is not guaranteed to be "OK" (e.g. HTTP/2 responses have no reason phrase and `statusText` is often `""` in undici/fetch), so a legitimate 200 response can be misclassified as a failure (or vice versa via a non-standard client), masking real refresh outcomes.
